primary_task: Build Expo development clients with EAS (cloud or local) and distribute via TestFlight / install on devices.

requirements.name: eas
requirements.check: command -v eas; npm view eas-cli version

requirements.name: expo
requirements.evidence: Building or distributing via EAS Build ... uses your EAS plan's build minutes

requirements.name: api.expo.dev
requirements.evidence: Build the development client in the cloud

requirements.name: apple-developer
requirements.evidence: needs a paid Apple Developer account for device/TestFlight distribution

requirements.name: mobile-device
requirements.evidence: Download the build from TestFlight on your device / adb install build.apk

notes: Even eas build --local requires Expo login. Android local build would also need the Android SDK/JDK (not checked). Apple account hard for TestFlight path, which is the headline workflow.
